races.name: Crottys Lake Maiden Hurdle
races.verdict:
DETROIT MAVERICK made a promising start in this sphere at Gowran and is narrowly preferred to World As One, who should also have races in him. Rond Point has shown promise in bumpers and could go well on his hurdling debut.

  1. DETROIT MAVERICK (IRE)
  2. WORLD AS ONE (GER)
  3. ROND POINT

races.name: Kilclooney Woods (Q.R.) Handicap Hurdle (0-100)
races.verdict:
LAKE CHAD switches back to hurdles off a handy mark and looks likely to make a bold bid for a yard in good form at present. Dark Lieutenant has more ability than he's been able to show to date and is likely to prove the main danger, while Kelly's Cosmos is well treated if able to build on small promise of his last run.

  1. LAKE CHAD (IRE)
  2. DARK LIEUTENANT (IRE)
  3. KELLY'S COSMOS (IRE)

races.name: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Mares Maiden Hurdle
races.verdict:
Plenty of dead wood in this maiden but the vote goes to WICKED PLEASURE, who made the frame sent hurdling after 8 months off at Roscommon recently and Henry de Bromhead's mare is entitled to come on from that here. Katie Can't Count showed improved form in this sphere last time, so she's put forward as the main danger sporting a first-time tongue tie, with Red Acres Georgie completing the shortlist.

  1. WICKED PLEASURE (IRE)
  2. KATIE CAN'T COUNT (IRE)
  3. RED ACRES GEORGIE (IRE)

races.name: Mahon Falls Novice Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
SILLY MONGOOSE is weighted to resume winning ways under a good-value claimer. He gets the nod over Ripsnorter, who is feared if building on his Downpatrick win at the second attempt. There's plenty of pace on paper, which could bring Private Policy and Soldier Saint into the mix, too.

  1. SILLY MONGOOSE (IRE)
  2. RIPSNORTER (FR)
  3. PRIVATE POLICY (IRE)

races.name: Suir Blueway Mares Chase
races.verdict:
LA NOTE VERTE looked potentially smart when cruising clear for a second successive victory at Listowel and appears to have been found a good opportunity to complete the hat-trick, with Emily Love having plenty to find on their latest meeting but still rating the one most likely to capitalise should the Willie Mullins representative underperform.

  1. LA NOTE VERTE
  2. EMILY LOVE (IRE)
  3. BYNX (IRE)

races.name: William Hill Challenge Series Handicap Chase
races.verdict:
CHARLIE LUCIANO ran well when third in a stronger race at Fairyhouse 12 days ago and looks capable of adding to his sole chase win if reproducing that form, with Kings Jet the main threat if his jumping holds up after an unlucky fall last time. Ned In The Park is also respected from a good mark if building on his latest effort.

  1. CHARLIE LUCIANO (IRE)
  2. KINGS JET (IRE)
  3. NED IN THE PARK (IRE)

races.name: Clonmel Oil Chase Day November 5th Handicap Chase (0-100)
races.verdict:
MOUNT SHENSHAN boasts excellent Clonmel form, including a handicap hurdle success here 3 weeks ago, and, racing off the same mark back over fences, she can follow up, with Wing Back feared most in first-time cheekpieces given he was a short-priced favourite last time and is clearly thought capable of better in this sphere, while Roccabaker and Shartheknowledge also appeal as potential improvers with just 3 chase starts between them.

  1. MOUNT SHENSHAN (IRE)
  2. WING BACK (IRE)
  3. ROCCABAKER (IRE)
  4. SHARETHEKNOWLEDGE (IRE)

races.name: bettingsites.co.uk Fast Withdrawal Mares' Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
FAIRY PARK was talented enough to finish placed in a Grade 2 bumper for her own sex at Aintree in April and this point winner should make no mistake on hurdling debut. Vrheligonne didn't achieve quite as much in that sphere as the selection but she's a nice jumping prospect in her own right. Funny Hunny may step up on her opening effort at Worcester.

  1. FAIRY PARK (IRE)
  2. VRHELIGONNE (FR)
  3. FUNNY HUNNY (IRE)

races.name: bettingsites.co.uk Instant Withdrawal Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race) (Div 1)
races.verdict:
Those with hurdling form do not set a high standard so QUICKKICK is offered to continue the good work he did in bumpers last season. Mourne Crystal was impressive when winning a point so he's on the shortlist, along with Spanish Stroll.

  1. QUICKKICK (IRE)
  2. MOURNE CRYSTAL (IRE)
  3. SPANISH STROLL

races.name: bettingsites.co.uk Instant Withdrawal Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race) (Div 2)
races.verdict:
This is likely to be won by a hurdling newcomer, with TROJAN TALE given the tentative nod given he was streetwise enough to win on his bumper debut last winter. The Walk did likewise so he's of interest, along with point recruits Common Sense, Oatsoeasy and Potter.

  1. TROJAN TALE (IRE)
  2. THE WALK (IRE)
  3. COMMON SENSE (IRE)

races.name: bettingsites.co.uk Same Day Payouts Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
Once-useful bumper performer KILWAUGHTER is still unexposed as a staying hurdler and may be able to defy a 6-month absence. One Eye On Vegas is feared for the in-form Stuart Edmunds team, along with interesting stable debutant El Gavilan.

  1. KILWAUGHTER (IRE)
  2. ONE EYE ON VEGAS
  3. EL GAVILAN (FR)

races.name: bettingsites.co.uk Get Paid By UK Betting Sites Open NH Flat Race (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
A bumper containing several interesting Rules newcomers, though none more so than WILLOW TIDE, who cost a packet after winning his completed start in Irish points and is the obvious choice before market clue. Poets Express and Pointofdifference are two other likely types who require close market scrutiny.

  1. WILLOW TIDE (IRE)
  2. POETS EXPRESS (IRE)
  3. POINTOFDIFFERENCE

races.name: bettingsites.co.uk Fast Paying Bookmakers Novices' Limited Handicap Chase
races.verdict:
Likely to prove strong form with several expected to up their game switched to fences. Top of that list is BOULTYDOOLIN as an Irish point winner who created a favourable impression at Chepstow. Call Me Legend also has more to offer this season, with Inishcorker, a stablemate of the selection not without interest, too.

  1. BOULTYDOOLIN (IRE)
  2. CALL ME LEGEND (IRE)
  3. INISHCORKER (IRE)

races.name: bettingsites.co.uk Quickest Withdrawal Bookies Handicap Chase
races.verdict:
A few with chances and it could pay to side with RAP SOUL to make a winning return given he had looked progressive until just a fair third at Fontwell on his final run. Harry Derham's fencing newcomer Crystello brings potential and could emerge as the chief threat ahead of The Grey Man and Gustapof.

  1. RAP SOUL (FR)
  2. CRYSTELLO (IRE)
  3. THE GREY MAN

races.name: bettingsites.co.uk Fast Withdrawal Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
JAIPALETEMPS struck up an excellent partnership with Rian Corcoran last season and the pair can combine for a sixth victory here. The leniently-treated Joker de Mai is feared most in his bid for a first success for his current yard, although Escapeandevade and Doctors Hill also need factoring into this open handicap.

  1. JAIPALETEMPS (FR)
  2. JOKER DE MAI (FR)
  3. ESCAPEANDEVADE (IRE)

races.name: Midnite A Next Generation Betting App Apprentice Handicap
races.verdict:
POPULAR DREAM saves his best for C&D and can defy a 5 lb rise to win here for the second time this month. One For Harvey got the better of Mimime when the pair met over C&D last month and both are respected again with the latter having scored since.

  1. POPULAR DREAM
  2. ONE FOR HARVEY
  3. MIMIME (IRE)

races.name: Midnite: Built For 2027 Not 2007 Handicap
races.verdict:
FRAM CASTLE was unlucky to bump into an improving younger rival at Kempton last week and Michael Wigham's in-form gelding can resume winning ways. Five Moons seemed to respond well to headgear at Yarmouth last week and is also considered, with joint top-weight Rubellite completing the shortlist.

  1. FRAM CASTLE (IRE)
  2. FIVE MOONS (IRE)
  3. RUBELLITE (IRE)

races.name: Midnite Are Upping The Betting Game Handicap
races.verdict:
Two-time course winner EVERYONEKNOWSADAVE looks the percentage call in a competitive-looking handicap. The dangers are headed by Flightofthephoenix and Sigliosa, who have both shaped with promise in defeat recently, with Celestias Comet another to consider.

  1. EVERYONEKNOWSADAVE (IRE)
  2. FLIGHTOFTHEPHOENIX (IRE)
  3. SIGLIOSA

races.name: All-Weather Championship Is Back Fillies' Handicap
races.verdict:
FILLY EILISH looks to have plenty in her favour and she's taken to record a second C&D success. Bofa Beach is feared as the main danger, with Imola best of the rest at the weights.

  1. FILLY EILISH (IRE)
  2. BOFA BEACH
  3. IMOLA (IRE)

races.name: AWC Finals Day At Newcastle 26th March Handicap
races.verdict:
A few with chances but PIAZZA failed by just a nose having been set too much to do here last time and can gain a deserved success off the same mark. The handily-weighted Decalogue heads the list of dangers on his tapeta bow, although recent Kempton scorer Gunfighter along with in-form duo Izzari and Rapide Vega also need factoring into this competitive handicap.

  1. PIAZZA
  2. DECALOGUE (USA)
  3. GUNFIGHTER (IRE)

races.name: AWC Season 14 Has Begun EBF Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
SILESIA's fifth in a listed event at the Ebor meeting sets the standard here so Kevin Ryan's filly gets the vote to open her account returned to calmer waters. Karl Burke has had a fantastic 2026 with his 2-y-o debutants and his Grateful Spirit could be the one to give the selection most to think about. Mohaymenah rounds off the shortlist returning from a 3-month absence.

  1. SILESIA
  2. GRATEFUL SPIRIT
  3. MOHAYMENAH (IRE)

races.name: Trials Day - Lingfield 2nd Jan 2027 Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
POINTED was still too rough around the edges to capitalise on good position at Redcar last month but with this drop to a sprint trip sure to suit, Jack Channon's filly can make it third time lucky at the expense of newcomer Acclamique, who ticks plenty of boxes on paper and is well drawn to attack. Astronette may prove best of the rest.

  1. POINTED (IRE)
  2. ACCLAMIQUE
  3. ASTRONETTE (IRE)

races.name: Make The Move To Midnite Handicap (Div 1)
races.verdict:
COME ON OVER is taken to end a run of second placings and gain a deserved third success of the season with the form of his most recent effort over C&D having been well advertised since. Hypnotised wasn't at his best when gambled-on here last time but must enter calculations back up in trip off a handy-looking mark, while Mighty Vega could take a step forward from a recent C&D seventh after a break and also have a say.

  1. COME ON OVER (IRE)
  2. HYPNOTISED
  3. MIGHTY VEGA (IRE)

races.name: Make The Move To Midnite Handicap (Div 2)
races.verdict:
KINIRO proved better than ever when scoring at Kempton last time and gets the nod after a 4 lb rise. Blue Orbit chased home the selection there and can be on the premises again, with the reliable French Affair also likely to be in the mix.

  1. KINIRO
  2. BLUE ORBIT (IRE)
  3. FRENCH AFFAIR (IRE)

races.name: CopyBet For Europa League Profit Boosts EBF Restricted Novice Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race) (Div 1)
races.verdict:
BYZANTINE is worth another chance to build on his debut win with this extra 1f sure to suit. Sydney Carton has a good chance on these terms but he may not be entirely straightforward, while the booking of Ryan Moore catches the eye for well-connected newcomer Munajad.

  1. BYZANTINE (IRE)
  2. SYDNEY CARTON
  3. MUNAJAD (IRE)

races.name: CopyBet For Europa League Profit Boosts EBF Restricted Novice Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race) (Div 2)
races.verdict:
HAPPY LOVE pulled clear of the rest when runner-up to the more experienced and now useful Rosberg in Beverley maiden in July and has been found an excellent opportunity after a break. Imperialism was getting the hang of things late at Kempton and is next best with improvement almost certain.

  1. HAPPY LOVE (GER)
  2. IMPERIALISM (IRE)
  3. RAISE AND SHINE (FR)

races.name: CopyBet Support Safer Gambling Fillies' Handicap
races.verdict:
Preference is for SILENT CITY, who won over C&D last year before improving further when second in this same event. She is taken to get back to winning ways returned to this track, though Nanoscience arrives in good form and is much respected back up in trip. Kamaway and Thursday Girl complete the shortlist.

  1. SILENT CITY
  2. NANOSCIENCE
  3. KAMAWAY

races.name: CopyBet Pay First Past The Post Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
Competitive stuff but ARBAAWY shaped best on his first attempt at this trip when just denied at Salisbury 3 weeks ago so is taken to finally break his duck. Kalokalo and Beach Point head the dangers.

  1. ARBAAWY
  2. KALOKALO (IRE)
  3. BEACH POINT (IRE)

races.name: CopyBet Proudly Backs UK Horse Racing Handicap
races.verdict:
ICE CUBE wasted no time getting back on the up when second at Nottingham last week, beaten only by an in-form rival, and he can build on that effort to record a third handicap success this year. Eazy On The Eye gained a deserved victory at Epsom on her latest outing and could be the main danger, ahead of Venetian Sky.

  1. ICE CUBE (IRE)
  2. EAZY ON THE EYE
  3. VENETIAN SKY (FR)

races.name: CopyBet Follow Us On X Handicap
races.verdict:
MO OF CAIRO has shaped as if ahead of his mark in defeat on his last couple of outings and Kevin Ryan's colt is fancied to make a successful journey from the North. The Quiet Gent has to be respected on the back of his Salisbury win, with the unexposed Space Party and Distant Rumble also on the shortlist.

  1. MO OF CAIRO
  2. THE QUIET GENT (IRE)
  3. SPACE PARTY (IRE)

races.name: CopyBet BOG Now For Cheltenham Tomorrow Handicap
races.verdict:
Not a typical handicap with IRISH NECTAR and Unico standing out off their current marks, the former taken to complete a quick-fire hat-trick under a double penalty.

  1. IRISH NECTAR
  2. UNICO
  3. MY MATE KEV

races.name: CopyBet Overnight Best Odds Guaranteed Apprentice Handicap
races.verdict:
A difficult finale to solve but preference is for ATMOSPHERE, who turned in his best effort of the season when finishing runner-up at Newcastle 10 days ago and a repeat should see Richard Spencer's 4-y-o go very close under recently crowned Champion Apprentice Jack Callan. Beauty Generation and Eloquencia both arrive in top form, so they look the biggest threats, with Guest House another to consider at forecast longer odds.

  1. ATMOSPHERE
  2. BEAUTY GENERATION (IRE)
  3. ELOQUENCIA

races.name: Class Of '63: 63 Years On Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
It's hard to look past PUSH THE LIMIT, who admittedly has a year-long absence to overcome on his hurdling debut but showed smart form on the Flat for Ralph Beckett in 2025 and was sold for a whopping 580,000 gns. Aye Over Tee is bred to make a useful jumper and warrants a close look in the betting, while Dilrisk and Striking Midnight are a couple with frame claims having shown some promise in bumpers last season.

  1. PUSH THE LIMIT (FR)
  2. AYE OVER TEE
  3. DILRISK (FR)

races.name: 50 Years Of The Window Shop Conditional Jockeys' Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
This could go the way of course specialist BEL AMIGO, who had some solid form in defeat last season and returns on a handy-looking mark. Sytadel, Winds of Winter and Caballo de Guerra also make plenty of appeal in a tricky handicap.

  1. BEL AMIGO (FR)
  2. WINDS OF WINTER (IRE)
  3. SYTADEL (FR)

races.name: Magnet, Better. By Design Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
Successful 3 times this season, SIR CARNEGIE came agonisingly close to another victory at Kelso earlier this month and he is taken to add to his tally this time round. Breizh River has been building up a good record for his present stable and is feared most, ahead of the in-form Sean Og.

  1. SIR CARNEGIE (IRE)
  2. BREIZH RIVER (FR)
  3. SEAN OG (IRE)

races.name: Race Home With Genesis Homes Handicap Hurdle (Div 1)
races.verdict:
LA LOLITA looks capable of making a winning start for the in-form Sam England team. Jetovango is feared, especially if supported on third start for capable yard. Gonnino, U S Marshall and Rickety Gate also need considering in a competitive handicap.

  1. LA LOLITA (FR)
  2. JETOVANGO (IRE)
  3. GONNINO (IRE)

races.name: Race Home With Genesis Homes Handicap Hurdle (Div 2)
races.verdict:
GETAWAY MASTER is 2 lb lower than when successful over Drop Kick here last year, and he may be able to confirm that form with the benefit of a comeback run. Is She Now looks a danger over hurdles for first time since joining current yard, with Royal Rhythm and Fourofakind others to consider in an open race.

  1. GETAWAY MASTER (IRE)
  2. DROP KICK (IRE)
  3. IS SHE NOW (IRE)

races.name: Panoramic Hurdle (Listed) (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
GOLDEN ACE has had valid excuses when falling short on reappearance the previous 2 seasons and her class may prevail this time. Burdett Road chased home Jeremy Scott's mare twice last season, and while better off at the weights this time, he hasn't been in top form on the Flat more recently. Wilful went from strength to strength last year and could have a say if picking up where he left off.

  1. GOLDEN ACE
  2. BURDETT ROAD
  3. WILFUL (IRE)

races.name: Thomas Armstrong Group 'Building The Future' Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
Preference is for GLORY AND HONOUR, who has eased to a handy mark returned to chasing and gets the blinkers back on which he's worn for his last 2 victories (over hurdles on latest). He gets the vote ahead of last year's winner of this race Hello Judge, while Dearkeithandkaty could be in the mix on chasing debut.

  1. GLORY AND HONOUR (IRE)
  2. HELLO JUDGE
  3. DEARKEITHANDKATY (FR)

races.name: GA Wilson Plastering Open NH Flat Race (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
CRYSTAL SPECTRE has a good pedigree and makes obvious appeal having joined the bang in-form Skeltons after finding only one too good on his sole start in Irish points. Midnight Jury and Junior Minister are others to note.

  1. CRYSTAL SPECTRE (IRE)
  2. MIDNIGHT JURY (IRE)
  3. JUNIOR MINISTER (IRE)

races.name: 4Racing Welcomes You Work Riders Maiden Plate
races.verdict:
ASTROPHILE stands out by some way on form. First Frost is appealing first time out, while Nicci Beach could be in the hunt.

  1. ASTROPHILE (SAF)
  2. FIRST FROST (SAF)
  3. NICCI BEACH (SAF)

races.name: youcanbetonus! Maiden Plate
races.verdict:
COMIC ARTIST gets the vote over this new trip. Fire Force is another who could have a big say in proceedings, while Jet Platino shouldn't be ruled out.

  1. COMIC ARTIST (SAF)
  2. FIRE FORCE (SAF)
  3. JET PLATINO (SAF)

races.name: Betway Summer Cup 28 November Maiden Plate
races.verdict:
BLUNDERBORE should be bang there. Uncle Bob is top of the dangers, while Rank And File might well have a say too.

  1. BLUNDERBORE (SAF)
  2. UNCLE BOB (SAF)
  3. RANK AND FILE (SAF)

races.name: Tickets At Howler For The Betway Summer Cup Maiden Plate (F & M)
races.verdict:
VISION OF GOLD is up to winning this with something in hand and is a straightforward pick. Blooming Lovely is the second option, while Purple Rain can win the battle for minor honours.

  1. VISION OF GOLD (SAF)
  2. BLOOMING LOVELY (SAF)
  3. PURPLE RAIN (SAF)

races.name: Tab Telebet 011 074 0300 Progress Plate
races.verdict:
TINA LOVELACE could be the way to go. Pretty Persuasive is a player, while The Bronx Bull is another to consider.

  1. TINA LOVELACE (SAF)
  2. PRETTY PERSUASIVE (SAF)
  3. THE BRONX BULL (SAF)

races.name: For Hospitality Bookings Call 011 681 1796 Mr 96 Handicap
races.verdict:
PRINCE OF KILDARE could be the way to go. Diwali Rocket is a big player again, while Mission To Mars also commands respect.

  1. PRINCE OF KILDARE (SAF)
  2. DIWALI ROCKET (SAF)
  3. MISSION TO MARS (IRE)

races.name: Racing Today Mr 84 Handicap
races.verdict:
QUEVANO just about gets the nod. Sunset Warrior is a big player, while Boundless Love is another likely to be on the premises.

  1. QUEVANO (SAF)
  2. SUNSET WARRIOR (SAF)
  3. BOUNDLESS LOVE (SAF)

races.name: Next Tab Turffontein Racemeeting Saturday 24 October Mr 66 Handicap
races.verdict:
KOVIL makes plenty of appeal. King Bluetooth is second choice, while Silver Comet is another with the potential to figure.

  1. KOVIL (SAF)
  2. KING BLUETOOTH (SAF)
  3. SILVER COMET (SAF)
